card.line: BITS Pilani mein poori fees maaf

scenes.vo: Do: BITS Pilani top rankers ki poori fees maaf karega, income limit hai.
Teen: Diesel export par tax badha, Indian Oil, BPCL, HPCL shares nazar mein.
Chaar: November mein Coal India, Infosys, HUL, Power Grid ki dividend dates.
Paanch: Sone-chaandi ke bhaav ab pichhle saal December jaise, shaadi ki kharidari sasti.
Chhah: Sasti keemat wale kai penny shares teen mahine mein bahut zyada toote.

card.line: Is hafte dividend aur bonus dates

scenes.vo: Saat: Is hafte Infosys, Asian Paints jaisi kai companies ki dividend, bonus dates.
Aath: PNB ke union ne fraud ke baad har branch ka audit maanga.
Nau: Amazon ne devices unit mein kai software naukriyan kaatin, wajah efficiency batayi.
Das: Reliance Digital iPhone par exchange offer, sasti keemat purana phone dene par.
Yeh investment advice nahi hai. Us dost ko bhejo, jo sone mein paisa lagaye baitha hai.
